limits: Read-only authenticated review of the available QA account does not establish all role-specific mutations or multi-account/provider journeys.
No production privacy cutover, production database hardening, permanent account erasure, provider setting change, payment, message send, publication or TestFlight release was performed.
Production cache/revocation compatibility and actual disposable-account Storage/CDN/Auth erasure remain open.
Physical iPhone media, Photos, camera, gestures, push/calls/audio/interruption/offline/accessibility acceptance remains open.
Licensed music, unsupported animated/nested/dual-camera composition and the other capabilities listed in the delivery report remain explicit implementation/provider boundaries.
